description: This file defines a BatchedChromaVectorStore class for managing batched storage and retrieval of vector data using ChromaDB, including a utility function for chunking lists of nodes.

classes.name: BatchedChromaVectorStore
classes.description: A vector store class that batches additions to a ChromaDB collection to optimize performance and avoid batch size limits.

methods.name: chunk_list
methods.description: Generator function that yields successive chunks of a list of nodes, each with a maximum size of max_chunk_size.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BatchedChromaVectorStore with ChromaDB client and collection, along with optional connection parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a sequence of nodes to the vector store in batches, handling chunking and metadata extraction.
